summary: Macro backdrop for ags: headwind (score -3 across rates, dollar, Brazil real, risk, energy, China, breadth). rates 0; dollar 0; brl −; risk 0; energy 0; china −; breadth −. sections.title: Rates
sections.text: US 10-year 5.10% (-11 bp in a month), 2-year 4.86% (+7 bp); 2s10s curve +24 bp (-18 bp in a month). Yields are little changed on the month. T-bill yield 4.13% sets the cost of carrying inventory.

sections.title: Dollar & farm currencies
sections.text: Dollar index 103.17 (+1.0% in a month, +5.0% YTD). USD/BRL 5.640 (+13.1% in a month): a weaker real encourages Brazilian farmer selling of soybeans, corn, sugar, coffee and cotton, pressuring world prices. USD/CNY 6.670 (-0.3%); USD/MXN 18.60 (+1.8%).

sections.title: Risk appetite
sections.text: S&P 500 -2.7% in a month (+10.9% YTD); VIX 19.0. Neutral risk backdrop.

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: WTI 88.93 $/bbl (-4.6% in a month), Brent 96.12, ULSD 4.303 $/gal (-9.9%), natural gas 3.34 (-7.4%). Crude little changed on the month.

sections.title: China & industrial demand
sections.text: Copper -8.0% in a month, Shanghai Composite -3.8%, Hang Seng -1.4%, yuan +0.3% vs USD. Soft China/industrial signals point to weaker import demand.

sections.title: Commodity breadth
sections.text: 8 of 33 commodities trade above their 50-day average (24%); S&P GSCI -7.5% in a month; gold -7.1%.
